mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, create_time, status, download_count) VALUES (#{originName}, #{storeName}, #{filePath}, #{ext}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId}, #{createTime}, #{status}, #{downloadCount})
mapper.select: SELECT ext AS ext, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} GROUP BY ext
